critical_code_review_comments: outbound.py is 1751 lines — should be split into smaller modules (parser, push endpoints, stats) for maintainability.

In exim-log-push-raw, base64.b64decode is lenient by default and can silently accept garbage input, producing empty log_text; current fallthrough to 'log_text boş' 400 works but a stricter validate=True call would give clearer errors.

The malformed-b64 test path currently returns 'log_text boş' rather than the 'log_text_b64 decode hatası' branch — consider using base64.b64decode(b64_val, validate=True) so garbage input triggers the more descriptive decode error.
